quest.title: Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp!
quest.description: Your diet has been quite plain recently, and Paimon's been missing the spice of life in food...\nAs such, you head over to Wanmin Restaurant, only to meet two old friends...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Look, over there by the hot pot stand... We know them!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}? Paimon? You're here too?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yanfei, Shinobu! Here for some hot pot, huh? What's the occasion?

choices.text: Has Wanmin Restaurant gone downhill, or something?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: No, it's nothing like that! Wanmin Restaurant's just closed for a couple of days.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: But it's nice to try somewhere different for a change. Su Er'niang's hot pot is pretty good, and you can't get it at Wanmin Restaurant.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wanmin's closed? Why, what happened?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Well, it was partly our fault...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Recently, some old classmates from the Tongwen Academy got in touch and said they were organizing a get-together.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Yanfei's the most senior among us, since she's the most qualified, so she got to pick the location, and she booked Wanmin Restaurant.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: The turnout was a lot higher than expected, and in the space of two days, we somehow got through all of the restaurant's stock for the week ahead. Boss's enormous appetite was also a significant contributing factor... he went a little crazy.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: Chef Mao was pretty wiped out by the end, but he had a huge smile on his face. It was the best business he's had in months.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: The only thing is, it'll take him a least a couple days to fully restock.

choices.text: ..."Boss"?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Bull-Chucker's here too!? Paimon's surprised we haven't seen him — those horns stick out like two sore thumbs...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Yeah... When he heard I was meeting up with some old classmates, he got very excited, and decided he was coming with me. His logic was, and I quote: "Any classmate of Shinobu's is a classmate of mine."

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Notwithstanding the fact that Boss has never studied a day in his life... I think he just feels that he didn't get enough chances to indulge his taste buds last time he was in Liyue.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: That other kid you guys brought with you, though — what was his name again...? Oh yeah, Grandmaster Hanakado. He seems like a smart cookie!

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: You probably didn't notice because you were busy chatting to your classmates at the time, but he was helping Chef Mao out in the kitchen, trying to pick up some Liyue cooking skills.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I suspect he just wanted to learn how to make some new dishes to feed to his Onikabuto and make them stronger.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Grandmaster Hanakado? Uh, where do we know that name from... Oh yeah, didn't we meet him during that beetle-battle thing that Bull-Chucker organized that one time?

choices.text: The "Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl"?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: That's right. Good memory, Paimon.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: After the near-catastrophe that was the Beetle Brawl, Hanakado became an ally of the Arataki Gang. He and Boss regularly hang out to have practice matches and discuss Onikabuto rearing strategies.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: But to his credit, a lot of the things he ropes Boss into doing in the name of beetle brawling actually result in Boss doing some real work for a change. It's made things a lot easier for me.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: For instance, they've decided to spend a few days helping Chef Mao restock the kitchen, partly to thank him for the "epic feast"...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: ...And partly because they would like to use the opportunity to look for new ingredients to boost their Onikabuto's performance.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: I think they're out looking for crabs at Guyun Stone Forest right now, with Miss Xiangling and Mr. Guoba...

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: They all seem to get along great! Guoba's already made friends with "Crimson Staff," as Itto calls it, and, uh... something-something "Beetle King," or whatever Hanakado's is called.

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: They've been out for quite a while, though... Shouldn't they be back by now?

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Unless something put them in a playful mood... in which case, it's anyone's guess what kind of mess they might be in by now.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, now Paimon wants to join in the fun!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Crabs from Guyun Stone Forest... Mmm, Paimon bets they taste great!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why don't we go see if they need our help? The sooner Wanmin Restaurant is fully stocked, the sooner we get to eat there again!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...And while we're at it, we can see what Bull-Chucker and Grandmaster Hanakado are really up to over there!

choices.text: Well, if we're serious about eating at Wanmin Restaurant...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: So you two are gonna head over?

response.speaker: Yanfei
response.text: #I think that's a great idea. {NICKNAME}, Paimon, and Itto make a good team — not everyone can get through to him, but he usually listens to you two.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: You make a good point. Well, thanks for checking up on them, you two.

choices.text: Gathering ingredients will go faster with more hands.
I can't remember. But anyway, it's not important.
...Itto?
Was Xiangling's cooking too hot to handle?

talks.objective: Go to Guyun Stone Forest to look for Xiangling and the others

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Ahhh, I see it now!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: A hard shell, a whole bunch of legs, looks like a born warrior — the Crab is the Onikabuto of the sea! Throw one of these bad boys in the ring, and your Onikabuto will have to seriously up its game!

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: That's right, Oni King! Technically, the crab belongs to a different species, but it has all the qualities of the perfect warrior-beetle! Pitting Onikabuto against Crabs during their training is a sure-fire way to rapidly improve their strength!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Then it's time for Crimson Staff and Ironclad Beetle King to train harder than ever before! No rest until they've flipped every Crab in the area onto its back!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: And once they're done, we'll just need to stoop down and scoop 'em up! No more chasing Crabs all over the beach!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Looks like Xiangling and Guoba are part of the gang now...

choices.text: Hahaha, time for Onikabuto versus Crab!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: #Huh? {NICKNAME}, Paimon! Fancy meeting you here! Are you guys out for a walk or something?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey Xiangling, hey Guoba!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, we were going to gorge ourselves at Wanmin Restaurant, but then we ran into Yanfei and Shinobu, who told us you were closed for a few days... So, we figured we'd come find you guys, and see if you needed any help.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Aw, you guys! Hee-hee, thanks for being such loyal customers. It's so kind of you to help!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: With Mr. Itto and the grandmaster helping me for the last couple of days, we've actually got most of the things we need now. All that's left for us to get are some fresh Crabs.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: And Crimson Staff and Ironclad Beetle King will be able to round them up for us in no time! If everything goes to plan...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: ...Uh-oh, I may have spoken too soon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: It's a Geovishap Hatchling! Bull-Chucker, Hanakado, watch out!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hold on! Stay calm, I'll assess the situation!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: ...Hard shell, check! Legs — not too many, but it more than makes up for that with the whole rolling thing. Yeah, looks like a mean fighter! THIS is what you wanna train your Onikabuto against!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Uhh... Ahem, h—how right you are, Oni King! With a training partner like this, an Onikabuto is sure to reach the apex of its abilities!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wh—What? Are they serious right now?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Wait, I think I recognize that thing!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It's always rolling around on a nearby island. It's made quite a reputation for itself as far as Guyun Geovishaps go — people have taken to calling it "Crystal Tornado"!

choices.text: Why "Tornado"?

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: It's because if you ever set foot on its little island, then it whooshes over and gives you a nasty whack on the head. It's really aggressive!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How did you... come to learn that...?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Oni King, allow me to send in the troops! I shall monitor the battle from a safe distance to assess our enemy's prowess...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Go, Ironclad Beetle King! Test your challenger to its limits!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Ah, Ironclad Beetle King!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: One hit and it's all over!? I don't believe it! Th—That's not possible!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Okay, listen up, Grandmaster! The glorified pet rock is clearly tougher than it looks. Time to show it what we're really made of!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: From what I've seen, our opponent has a lot of brute force, but no finesse. Lugging all that weight around is a recipe for crude and clumsy attacks — and if you don't land the hit, it ain't worth squat! Luckily for us, our Onikabuto have a little thing called agility on their side...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Go, Crimson Staff! Dodge the limbs and tail, wait for an opening, and aim for the...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: ...Belly.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Oni King... Shall I send in some more Onikabuto, or...?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Uhh... I... wha... yo... ch... wha?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what's Guoba doing? Nooo!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... the vishap can understand Guoba? Huh, it just upped and left!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: So, to answer your question from a moment ago, Paimon...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: I found out about Crystal Tornado's aggressive tendencies the last time we came to gather Crabs in Guyun Stone Forest. Tornado gave Guoba a big old bash on the head the moment he saw him...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: But then, Tornado fell unconscious, and apparently wasn't seen for weeks afterwards. I guess he's finally recovered from his injuries.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Man, what a cool guy! I mean, I figured he was a pretty epic dude just from the look of him, but... I've never seen someone just stare an enemy into submission like that...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: There's only one possible conclusion... This is a warrior with strength the likes of which I've never seen before!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: I must say, I concur... I don't know how, but Guoba-san simply commanded that hard-shelled beast to stand down and retreat at once.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Come to think of it, he seems like a pro at catching Crabs, too... Hmm, Guoba-san clearly has some sort of power that lets him bend the minds of shelled organisms to his will...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: ...That's it! The truth has been hiding in plain sight all this time — Guoba-san is a virtuoso beetle-battler! With his skills, he can direct an Onikabuto's each and every move.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? Of course... Yeah, that makes total sense! Haha, these are the kind of brainwaves that make you the Arataki Gang's greatest ally.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If we can get Guoba-san to teach us the art of shelled-organism mind control, we'll be unstoppable! The entire beetle-fighting world will be our oyster!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: Can we stop discussing what special powers Guoba may or may not have? We have to get these Crabs back before too long, or they'll go bad. And then this whole trip will have been a waste!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right! Get a move on, Bull-Chucker, Shinobu's waiting for you! Also, we wanna eat.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? Wait, when did we get two new people?

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Ohhhh! Compadre! Haha, if it isn't the Oni King's Right Hand — and of course, the Flying Lav— Ahem, uh, sorry, Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Wait... Ah man, don't tell me you saw me lose that beetle fight just now!? Gah, so humiliating!

choices.text: It's all good. Nothing we haven't seen before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, come on, there's nothing to be embarrassed about. Onikabuto don't stand a chance against a Geovishap Hatchling! Next time, just give it a couple of whacks with your club.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But that would defeat the whole purpose! Lemme explain. Now, it's no secret that you've kicked a fair share of butt in your time — and from what I hear, that includes some of the biggest, most powerful, and meanest butt around.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: So how'd you do it, huh? Were you born stronger than your most fearsome foe? No! Do you rock up to every fight believing that your odds of winning are a hundred percent? Of course not!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: You start with an impossible goal: defeating the unbeatable enemy. And then you do whatever you gotta do to achieve it! Because even you can't know how much potential you have until you push yourself past your limits. THAT'S how you make yourself not just stronger... but stronger than you ever imagined you could be!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Flee the fight once, you'll probably flee the next time, and the time after that... Next thing you know, you're that boring little twerp who never had the guts to put himself out there. 'Cause when you flee the fight... all you're really running away from is the person you could've become.

choices.text: Wow. Couldn't have put it better myself.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? What's gotten into Bull-Chucker? He actually said something that made sense! For once, Paimon has nothing to argue back...

response.speaker: Someone's Belly
response.text: *rumble*...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: You hear that? Guoba's getting hungry. Crystal Tornado's gone now anyway, and your Onikabuto won't be ready to fight again any time soon.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: So... are you just gonna stand here gawking, or...?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Chef-sama makes a good point. We are still far from being worthy enough to seek the tutelage of the mighty sensei, Guoba-san.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: I have heard tell of a great contest of fine warriors that was once held in this place. We stand on hallowed ground, and the very air we breathe is abuzz with the might of great duelists...

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: ...I say we set up a ring, here and now. I shall summon the mightiest beetle-battlers of Liyue, and as iron sharpens iron, we will hone our skills in training with them. Then, and only then, will we be ready to seek the guidance of Guoba-san.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Once we have learned his ways, we will track down that shelle{RUBY#[S]"Crystal Tornado"}d beast and do battle against it once more!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon's got a... well, a feeling about this, but not actually sure if it's a good one or a bad one...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Huh? Oh... OHHHHHHHH!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: I'm with you, Grandmaster! You're saying the time has come... to unveil the plan!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: This is the moment! It's time for the long-awaited "Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp"!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: That's right! There's no time to lose, Oni King. Let's set up the arena!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, heeey! We weren't done talking to you yet! Ugh, unbelievable. Look at them, not a care in the world...

choices.text: Alright! More beetle-fighting, woo!

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: What did they say it was called again? The Arataki... something-something... Anyway, some sort of beetle-fighting tournament, right? I think Hanakado might have mentioned it before.

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: If I wasn't so busy with work at the restaurant, I'd love to take Guoba along and watch...

response.speaker: Xiangling
response.text: But right now, the top priority is dealing with all these fresh Crabs. Come on, let's head back!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Shinobu was saying the Arataki Gang came to Liyue for her classmates' reunion, right? Won't throwing an impromptu beetle-fighting competition interfere with their plans?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...Well, not much we can do about it except head back to Wanmin and tell Shinobu.

choices.text: I always have time for Itto's number one passion.
I'm speechless. Nothing to add.
Haha, my bad. Sorry for lurking.
Why not... "Earthquake"?
Hehehe, sign me up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yanfei, Shinobu! We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: #Guoba, Xiangling, {NICKNAME}, and Paimon... Wait, where are the other two?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Lemme guess... Itto and Hanakado are up to their usual antics?

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: We'll fill you in shortly! First, I need to get all these pristine ingredients safely stored away — the Mist Flower Corollas won't keep the Crabs cool for much longer!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: #Plus, {NICKNAME} and Paimon are valued customers eagerly awaiting a grand feast! I'll get cooking, then we can catch up while we eat...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Xiangling and Guoba whip up a meal from ingredients collected on their trip. It's not long before an exceptional meal is served.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: By now, Yanfei and Shinobu are hungry too. The feasting begins.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As you dine, you tell Shinobu and Yanfei about Itto and Hanakado's run-in with Crystal Tornado, and the plan to hold a beetle-fighting boot camp...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: "Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp"? That doesn't bode well. It won't be long before things get out of hand...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: We're guests here, which means we're supposed to be on our best behavior... Leave them to me, I'll put a stop to it.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Mmm, I dunno, I think it could be fun... Anyway, don't stress! Beetle-fighting sounds like a great event idea!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: According to The Comprehensive Compendium of Liyue Law, we just need to notify the relevant office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and they'll issue a permit pretty much right away.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: You never know, maybe you'll make some new friends with this event! Then you'll have even more people to hang out with when you next come to Liyue!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Yeah! And you can bring them all to Wanmin Restaurant for your meals!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Wait... First the event, and now you're already planning our next trip?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Given the Arataki Gang's financial situation—

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Ah, c'mon, you gotta learn to cut loose more! You came all this way — you should be focused on catching up with old friends, making some new ones, and just generally hanging out and doing lots of fun stuff!

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: I need to be at the Ministry of Civil Affairs shortly for something else anyway, so I can get the ball rolling for Itto's thing while I'm there.

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Alright — I'll handle that while you guys head back to Itto and help get the venue set up. I'll join you later and bring the permit with me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Yanfei's in a good mood today... She didn't take any persuading to help out with the event.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: Well, event-planning's right up her alley. She was an officiator in the Masterful Chefs contest, and she has a lot of contacts because of her work.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: She's also on vacation at the moment, and her old friend Shinobu's in town. That's definitely put her in the mood to have some fun.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Well, I've missed my chance to discuss the issue of our funds. Guess I've got no choice but to deal with Boss directly now.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, Paimon, thanks for all your help so far. I promise I'll make it up to you the next time we meet!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You mean, you don't need us to come with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But if Itto's serious about defeating that Geovishap Hatchling with Onikabuto, Paimon's kinda curious to see how everything goes down...

choices.text: We'll help you deal with Boss!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Now that you mention it... Didn't you help Boss out a lot at the last one of these? The Almighty Arataki Extraordinary and Exhilarating Extreme Beetle Brawl?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, we didn't really help out, we just played a few matches... But it was actually super fun.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Either way, it sounds like you understand Boss's perspective far better than I do, so maybe you'll be able to help me talk some sense into him. I'll take all the help I can get.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Sure. Or, uh, y'know... Maybe we could just let him go ahead with it... huh?

choices.text: We wanna join the competition, too!

talks.objective: Go to Guyun Stone Forest again

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Alright, Boss. Funtime in Liyue is over. Let's head home.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Shinobu!? I... I can explain!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: No, you can't. Our funds have run out.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: We've spent too long here. After buying our tickets for the boat home, the gang fund is down to double-digits. How can we possibly afford to hold a tournament?

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Yanfei senpai very kindly offered to handle the legalities, otherwise you wouldn't even have a permit. Are you expecting her to foot the bill as well? Put a stop to this now, before things get out of control.

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: But, but...! You don't understand, we have a situation here! Normally, I'm happy to do things your way, but the Arataki Gang's two top Onikabuto warriors just lost to some pet rock called Crystal Tornado!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Look, we have a whole arena set up and everything! If we back out now, we'll be the laughing stock of the entire beetle-fighting world!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You've lost plenty of beetle fights before. Even I can beat you, and I'm not even a serious player. Why are you so bothered about losing to some vishap hatchling?

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Shinobu! That was a low blow!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Anyway, that's ancient history! I'm on a whole different level now. There isn't a single beetle fighter out there who can touch me! I'm serious about beating that pet rock. Don't think I've got what it takes? Try me!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Gladly. You wanna do this the hard way? We'll do it the hard way.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Grandmaster Hanakado, get me and Boss a beetle each. Maybe he'll be more amenable to reason after a crushing defeat.

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: If I win, you have to come back with me — no complaining, and no making any more trouble for Yanfei senpai.

dialogues.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
dialogues.text: Shinobu! Oni King! I...

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: You're really doing this, huh? I, uh... didn't think you'd take it this far!

dialogues.speaker: Arataki Itto
dialogues.text: Okay, uh... so... Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon! I delegate this challenge to you!

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: You're making Paimon fight me?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehehe, no surprises there.

choices.text: No surprises here either...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What Bull-Chu{RUBY#[S]"Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King"}cker is really saying is... "If you wanna fight the Oni King, you have to go through Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon first!"

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Exactamundo, amigo. Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon is one of the Arataki Gang's top beetle fighters, but even she isn't in the same league as moi. So Shinobu, if you wanna duel with the don, you gotta beat the melon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Except... Paimon refuses!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: What!?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Even Paimon knows that you can't just expect other people to pick up your slack all the time. It's not right! So if you're out of Mora, then tough luck — you gotta watch your spending.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: If Paimon helps you out, that'll just make more trouble for Yanfei, and then Shinobu will owe her a favor.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Okay, true... You make a fair point.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But it's all good! I have a backup plan for situations like this!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: If we really are out of funds, then... I'll find a job. I'll work nights, do beetle fighting during the day, and pay any expenses out of my own pocket!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: It'll work. The Grandmaster has helped me find a few good gigs before. As long as it's physical work and the pay's good, I'll take it!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Now you're talking! See, that's the kind of attitude Paimon can get behind.

choices.text: When you're the top dog, you watch the bottom line!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I can't believe you guys...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Your plan is all well and good, and I do hope you try not to be a burden on other people. But you still need to beat me first.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I know what Boss is trying to do: He's making me fight Paimon first to use up my Onikabuto's stamina. Well, good luck with that — even with a disadvantage, I'm still not gonna make this easy for you!

choices.text: Don't rely on someone else when you can do it yourself!
Itto is so predictable...

talks.objective: Engage in a beetle battle with Kuki Shinobu
Return to the beetle battle arena

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: After a fierce battle, Shinobu's Onikabuto narrowly loses to Crimson Staff under Paimon's direction...

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: I lost... I can't believe it...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That... that was so tense! Shinobu nearly got the better of Paimon there...

choices.text: What a dazzling duel!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Hey hey! Hahaha, hey hey! Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon destroys Shinobu on the first attempt, haha! ...You really are a natural at this, aren't you?

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: As agreed, we now have Shinobu's official support to host the Arataki Blazing Armor Beetle Battle Boot Camp!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I haven't battled in ages. Guess I'm out of practice...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I'll have to move to plan B: Try to keep costs to a minimum, and make sure Yanfei senpai doesn't end up doing everything for us...

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: I'm gonna hold you to your word, Boss! Fund this event yourself by working nights, battle beetles all you want during the day.

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: And one other thing... Our boat tickets home were booked well in advance. I can amend the date, but only by a few days. So keep this event to maybe four or five other people tops, or you'll run out of time, okay? I don't want you getting carried away.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Got it! Sure! Promise! Cross my heart and hope to die! Shinobu, you've got nothing to worry about!

response.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
response.text: Okay, I'll head down to the harbor and see about changing the tickets... I'm warning you, you'd better not go spending all our Mora while I'm gone!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Okay... So we've only got five battles to get in shape enough for Guoba-san. Then we gotta master what he teaches us, THEN take down that cocky pe{RUBY#[S]"Crystal Tornado"}t rock...

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Shinobu is asking us to do the impossible here!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: But this is the kind of hardcore challenge I live for! Hahahaha!

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Don't worry, Oni King. I'll find people to join us in our great training endeavor. So long as there are worthy beetle-battlers to be found, I'll be sure to sense their presence, and bring them over to our camp.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: We haven't been in Liyue for long, but I'm certain that this vast land is filled with mighty warriors... We'll have no trouble finding but one of these each day.

response.speaker: Grandmaster Hanakado
response.text: Now, as for the esteemed Oni King's Right Hand and honorable Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon—

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Ohoho, we've done our part! We saved your butts by getting Shinobu to agree to this! Paimon saw the look of sheer terror on your faces, you're clearly no match for her!

choices.text: It would be conventional to show your gratitude with a gift.

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Oh... Of course, heh! I will, uh... leave it to me! I'll come up with something! You'll get your reward, don't you worry!

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: In the meantime, if the Oni King's Right Hand and Skycleaving White-Iron Lavender Melon don't have other plans, then prepare to watch history in the making:

response.speaker: Arataki Itto
response.text: Cause in a few short days, I, the Bona-Fide Beetle Battle King, will raise my game to new heights, win the respect of Guoba-san, and become a living legend! Booyah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Cool! Yeah, we'll be watching! So, uh, no pressure or anything, but...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: ...If you mess this up and everyone completely wipes the floor with you, we'll see the whooole thing!

choices.text: Surely the Arataki Gang gives credit where credit is due?
What a fantastic fight!

dialogues.speaker: Wanmin Restaurant Notice
dialogues.text: "Due to a shortage of ingredients, Wanmin Restaurant will be closed for a week..."

dialogues.speaker: Wanmin Restaurant Notice
dialogues.text: "We'd like to thank all our customers for your understanding and support. We will reopen as soon as we can, and continue providing the most delectable of dishes for everyone!"

dialogues.speaker: Kuki Shinobu
dialogues.text: Ugh... I'm suddenly feeling a bit warm. Maybe I've been eating too much spicy food lately...?

dialogues.speaker: Yanfei
dialogues.text: Oh no, you poor thing! It could be a fever, or maybe the humidity's making you overheat? Wait here, I'll go get you some iced tea!

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: We've already beaten our expected turnover for this month, and it'll still be a while before dad gets back with the rest of the new stock. So, we should be able to take it easy for a while.

dialogues.speaker: Xiangling
dialogues.text: After that, we should be back to business as usual — things won't be anywhere near as busy as they've been the last few days. That means, we should have time to go and watch Mr. Itto's beetle-fighting event!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Hey, you know where we haven't been in the longest time? Wanmin Restaurant.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon suddenly has a craving for food that makes you feel like your mouth's on fire! {NICKNAME}, can we go to Wanmin Restaurant, pleeease?
